domain: community sports league fixtures (DOMAIN_ID 7), database s9871_rel
note: The three fixed verification cases for HW7 Parts 2-3 (and reused by Part 5). Each needs at least two tool calls with no follow-up prompting. The expected outcomes are NOT stored here: they are recomputed from the live database by code/agent_cases.py, so they cannot drift from the data.

cases.name: search, then detail lookup of the first result
cases.prompt: Search for fixtures matching 'Lions' and give me the full details of the first search result.
cases.expected_chain: search_fixtures(query contains 'lions') then fixture_details(id = id of the FIRST search result)

cases.name: aggregate question, then one supporting example
cases.prompt: Which team hosts the most fixtures? Then find one fixture hosted by that team as a supporting example.
cases.expected_chain: team_fixture_counts then a follow-up search_fixtures or fixture_details that finds an example fixture

cases.name: compare two entities: search plus two detail lookups
cases.prompt: Compare the first two fixtures matching 'Basketball': give each one's fixture code and its home team.
cases.expected_chain: search_fixtures(query contains 'basketball') then fixture_details for BOTH of the first two result ids
